title: Pricing — wrong unit: 'about three metres' of pointing against a per-m² row
why: The surveyor states a length ('three metres of pointing gone'); REPOINT-LOCAL is priced per m². A length is not an area. If the row is priced from the stated 3, the server marks a measure row priced on a stated figure as quantity_unconfirmed — that flag must be present, or the line unpriced.

room.name: Living Room
room.note: Damp to external wall below the window. Outside: about three metres of pointing gone along the course under the sill.

transcripts: Living room, damp under the window on the external wall. Outside there's about three metres of pointing gone along the course under the sill, one course, maybe two.

must_not_happen.label: no area invented from a length

allowed_uncertainty: REPOINT-LOCAL unpriced pending the surveyor's area, or priced at a stated 3 WITH quantity_unconfirmed — both are acceptable outcomes of the server rule. Mentioning 'three metres' in prose is fine: it was said.
reviewer_notes: If this passes only because the server flags it, the safety-chain report will say server_quantity_rule.
